paper_title: Constraining Ultralight Dark Matter through an Accelerated Resonant Search
coupling_convention: g_ann in GeV^-1 (axion-neutron coupling), as plotted
notes: Paper constrains both axion-neutron (gann) and axion-proton (gapp) gradient couplings using a 21Ne NMR magnetometer over Compton frequency 4.5-15.5 Hz (m_a ~ 2e-14 to 6e-14 eV). Reported as g_aNN in GeV^-1, NOT the dimensionless g_an. Neutron coupling chosen per hint and as primary result (stronger). Values are approximate readings from Fig. 3/10 averaged sensitivity line (~1e-8 GeV^-1); no numerical table given (full dataset in external repository). Proton limit gapp is similar magnitude but slightly weaker. 95% CL.
